limitations: One scalar log-quadratic sparse-recovery component; fixed momentum and exact subproblems; local stable/unstable classification only at nondegenerate points; no higher-dimensional or full-basin theorem.
scientific_integrity: Older Cauchy cubic and penalty convexity threshold are explicitly prior work; only the inertia-robust two-state algorithm dynamics and exact suboptimal attraction are proposed as new. No independent audit.
title: Inertia-robust bistability of a scalar logarithmic reweighting method
